_comment: <httpRuntime fcnMode>: which changes restart an application (#167, #189). Host.Tests' FileChangeNotificationTests
asserts webForCore's decision (bin_dotnet for bin) on Linux and Windows; CI's iis-compare job (tools/ci/iis_fcn.cs)
checks IIS 10's on the same sites. 'iis' is IIS 10's decision in every run or, with 'varies', in most runs: webForCore
must make that decision. iis_fcn.cs fails when IIS decides otherwise, except in a case that varies, which it records.
'varies' says how often IIS decided otherwise (CI's iis-compare runs and .github/workflows/iis-fcn-stability.yml).

cases.varies: IIS 10 restarted the application in 1 of 149 runs (#189)
IIS 10 didn't restart the application within 20 s in 6 of 149 runs (#189)
